title: HDMI Ports NOT working?  Faulty TV Fixed with a HEAT Gun !!!!!!!
description:
Hi, this video shows you how to fix a broken LG TV using a HEAT Gun. The HDMI Main board had failed so you could not connect any HDMI leads to the TV as it showed no signal. By using heat from a hot air heat gun it has fixed the faulty HDMI board. 
Please make sure you unplug the TV from the electric supply and fully understand the dangers of working with electric and electronics before opening up a TV.
author: My Mate VINCE
